description: You are the IT Operations Manager and your manager has escalated an urgent concern: the service desk's SLA compliance rate for high-priority incidents has dropped to 22% this month. Reviewing the ticket queue, you find three Open, High-priority service requests that have been sitting unattended — a keyboard issue, a printer jam issue, and a VPN connectivity issue. Your remediation tasks: (1) Change the status of all three Open High-priority requests to 'In Progress' and assign each one to the 'administrator' technician. (2) Create a new Problem record titled 'Recurring SLA Compliance Failures - High Priority Response Times' with High priority, and link all three of those service requests to the Problem as related incidents. Log in with username: administrator, password: administrator.

metadata.problem_title: Recurring SLA Compliance Failures - High Priority Response Times
